result.summary: The page appears visually clean and well-structured with no critical or major defects. One minor styling observation was noted regarding the truncation of a restaurant name, though this may be intentional design for a horizontally scrolling list.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated at the screen edge without an ellipsis indicator, which could confuse users about whether the text continues.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation includes an ellipsis (...) to clearly indicate that the name is cut off, or adjust the card width to accommodate the full text if possible.
